title: Balti Sauce for Everything Curry
ingredients: 5cm piece of fresh root ginger, finely chopped
2 red chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
steps: Mix ground spices in a small bowl.
Fry onions in cooking spray for 8 minutes; add garlic, ginger and chillies; stir-fry 1 minute. Add spice mix; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes; fill can with water; add with passata, lemon juice and salt. Stir; simmer 30 minutes.
Add leftovers: meat — heat through thoroughly; canned chickpeas or quick-cooking vegetables — lid on, simmer 10 minutes; pre-cooked potato — add direct.
notes: Great for using up leftover roast chicken, lamb, beef or turkey, or making into a vegetarian curry with peppers, cauliflower, potato or chickpeas.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
